title: Getting started with raisr
text: RAIS (Relação Anual de Informações Sociais) annual census formal employment Brazil: every employer declares, year, employment relationships held (admission separation dates, occupation, wages month month, worker characteristics) establishments . Ministry Labour Employment publishes public, non-identified microdata PDET FTP server, one folder per reference year: regional files employment relationships (vinculos) large: 130 MB compressed North, 600 MB Northeast 1 GB Sao Paulo, tens millions records. raisr three things files: lists server resolves archive holds state; downloads archives idempotent local cache; reads stream, filtering state selecting columns anything kept memory. third point makes package useful ordinary laptop: one state Northeast fraction regional file, never hold rest memory.
code: ftp://ftp.mtps.gov.br/pdet/microdados/RAIS/     1985/ ... 2017/      one file per state (PE2017.7z, ...) + ESTB2017.7z     2018/ ... 2025/      RAIS_VINC_PUB_<REGION>.7z (7 regional files) + RAIS_ESTAB_PUB.7z     2023 Parcial/        preliminary edition of a year, when one was published     2023/Legado/         the previous files, kept when a year is re-published

title: Streaming, cache and file generations
text: .7z archive holds single text file: Latin-1, one header line, one record per line. Extracted, regional file several gigabytes text (establishments file 2023 alone 1.3 GB), naive read.csv() needs many times memory. rais_read() never extracts archive. opens read connection compressed entry archive::archive_read(), libarchive decompresses fly, hands connection readr::read_delim_chunked(). Every chunk (500,000 lines default) goes callback : keeps records whose municipality code starts one requested states (uf); keeps requested columns. survives callback accumulated. Everything read character first, typed end (wages doubles, integer codes integers, Ministry’s ignored marker NA), two file generations write numbers differently. chunk size memory/speed trade-: 500,000 lines 60 short columns hundred megabytes peak. Lower small machine; result :
code: f <- system.file("extdata", "2022", "RAIS_VINC_PUB_NORDESTE_sample.7z", package = "raisr") a <- rais_read(f, chunk_size = 5L, verbose = FALSE) b <- rais_read(f, chunk_size = 100000L, verbose = FALSE) identical(a, b) #> [1] TRUE

title: Streaming, cache and file generations
text: RAIS 2022 (partial legacy editions) files ;-separated decimal comma, padded fields headers Vínculo Ativo 31/12; ignored marker {ñ class}. RAIS 2023 onwards files ,-separated quoted strings, decimal point headers Ind Vínculo Ativo 31/12 - Código, two columns added (ind_vinculo_abandonado, categoria_trabalhador). rais_read() detects generation header line maps normalized names, different years stack directly: rais_layout() lists two spellings every column: 2018 files per state shorter: monthly wage columns exist 2015 (named vl_rem_<mes>_cc 2017, vl_rem_<mes>_sc ), oldest years use classifications (cbo_ocupacao, grau_instrucao_2005_1985). Columns absent year come back NA years stacked rais_fetch().
code: new <- rais_read(system.file("extdata", "2024", "RAIS_VINC_PUB_NORDESTE_sample.7z", package = "raisr"),                  columns = c("municipio", "vinculo_ativo_31_12", "vl_remun_media_nom"), verbose = FALSE) old <- rais_read(f, columns = c("municipio", "vinculo_ativo_31_12", "vl_remun_media_nom"), verbose = FALSE) rais_stock(rbind(new, old)) #> # A tibble: 2 × 3 #>   rais_year records stock #>       <int>   <int> <int> #> 1      2022      32     0 #> 2      2024      32    24 subset(rais_layout(), original != original_2023)[, c("column", "original", "original_2023")] #> # A tibble: 44 × 3 #>    column              original            original_2023                #>    <chr>               <chr>               <chr>                        #>  1 bairros_sp          Bairros SP          Bairros SP - Código          #>  2 bairros_fortaleza   Bairros Fortaleza   Bairros Fortaleza - Código   #>  3 bairros_rj          Bairros RJ          Bairros RJ - Código          #>  4 causa_afastamento_1 Causa Afastamento 1 Causa Afastamento 1 - Código #>  5 causa_afastamento_2 Causa Afastamento 2 Causa Afastamento 2 - Código #>  6 causa_afastamento_3 Causa Afastamento 3 Causa Afastamento 3 - Código #>  7 motivo_desligamento Motivo Desligamento Motivo Desligamento - Código #>  8 cbo_ocupacao_2002   CBO Ocupação 2002   CBO 2002 Ocupação - Código   #>  9 cnae_20_classe      CNAE 2.0 Classe     CNAE 2.0 Classe - Código     #> 10 cnae_95_classe      CNAE 95 Classe      CNAE 95 Classe - Código      #> # ℹ 34 more rows

title: Streaming, cache and file generations
text: rais_download() stores every archive rais_cache_dir(), mirroring server: one sub-folder per year edition, server’s file name inside. file already cache downloaded (status = "cached") unless force = TRUE. lets call rais_fetch() years repeatedly, different states columns, pay download . rais_read() takes reference year folder name (file name pre-2018 files); pass year explicitly archive kept elsewhere. cache location resolved cache_dir argument, RAISR_CACHE_DIR environment variable, raisr.cache_dir option, folder tempdir() (CRAN-compliant default, wiped R session). persistent cache strongly recommended: regional file hundreds megabytes Ministry’s server slow.
code: <cache>/2024/RAIS_VINC_PUB_NORDESTE.7z <cache>/2024/RAIS_ESTAB_PUB.7z <cache>/2023-legado/RAIS_VINC_PUB_NORDESTE.7z <cache>/2017/PE2017.7z Sys.setenv(RAISR_CACHE_DIR = "~/dados/rais") rais_cache_list() rais_cache_clear(2019)      # drop one year

text: Everything reads data can tried offline sample archives shipped inst/extdata:
code: library(raisr)  # What is on the server for 2024? rais_available(year = 2024)  # Which archive holds Pernambuco in 2024? (offline) rais_files(2024, uf = "PE")  # Pernambuco (IBGE code 26), RAIS 2024, a few columns. # Downloads the NORDESTE regional file (about 600 MB) once, into the cache. Sys.setenv(RAISR_CACHE_DIR = "~/dados/rais") pe <- rais_fetch(2024, uf = "PE",                  columns = c("municipio", "cnae_20_subclasse", "vinculo_ativo_31_12",                              "mes_admissao", "mes_desligamento", "vl_remun_dezembro_nom"))  # Stock on 31/12, admissions, separations and December payroll by municipality rais_stock(pe, by = "municipio")  # Several years stack on the same column names, whatever the header generation pe_serie <- rais_fetch(2019:2024, uf = "PE", columns = c("municipio", "vinculo_ativo_31_12")) rais_stock(pe_serie)  # Establishments instead of employment relationships est <- rais_fetch(2024, uf = "PE", type = "estabelecimentos") f <- system.file("extdata", "2024", "RAIS_VINC_PUB_NORDESTE_sample.7z", package = "raisr") rais_read(f, uf = "PE")

text: Queries public FTP server Ministry Labour Employment returns every RAIS archive currently published, one row per file, size date last modified server. Ministry publishes RAIS year around second half following year, sometimes preceded partial edition ("parcial"), keeps previous files Legado folder year re-published ("legado").

title: List the RAIS archives published on the PDET/MTE FTP server — rais_available
text: year Optional integer vector years restrict listing (example 2020:2025). NULL (default) lists every year since 1985, takes one FTP request per year folder. timeout Connection timeout seconds FTP request. verbose Emit progress messages? Defaults getOption("raisr.verbose", TRUE).

text: year Reference years (integer character vector). uf Optional states cover, IBGE two-digit codes (26) two-letter abbreviations ("PE"). NULL covers every state (regional files, 27 state files). type files: "vinculos" (employment relationships, default), "estabelecimentos" (establishments) . edition "final" (default), "parcial" (preliminary edition years receive final one) "legado" (previous files, kept Legado sub-folder year re-published). cache_dir Optional cache directory (see rais_cache_dir()). force Re-download archives already cache? timeout Timeout seconds file. verbose Emit progress messages? Defaults getOption("raisr.verbose", TRUE).

title: Download RAIS archives — rais_download

title: Read a RAIS archive as a stream — rais_read
text: Reads text file inside .7z archive RAIS without extracting disk without loading whole file memory: text decompressed stream parsed chunks, chunk filtered state reduced requested columns kept. makes practical extract one state (million records large one) regional file tens millions records modest machine.

title: Read a RAIS archive as a stream — rais_read
code: rais_read(   path,   uf = NULL,   columns = NULL,   types = TRUE,   year = NULL,   chunk_size = 500000L,   verbose = NULL )

title: Read a RAIS archive as a stream — rais_read
text: path Path archive, returned rais_download(). uf Optional states keep, IBGE two-digit codes (26) two-letter abbreviations ("PE"). state derived first two digits establishment's municipality code (municipio). NULL keeps every record. columns Optional character vector columns keep, using normalized names listed rais_layout(). NULL keeps columns. municipio always read (needed filtering) returned requested columns NULL. types Convert numeric columns? Ministry's marker ignored values (token braces, {n class} tilde n) becomes NA every column; remuneration values tenure become doubles; codes counts whose values integers become integers; classification codes leading zeros (CNAE, CBO) stay character. FALSE every column returned character, exactly file (trimmed). year Reference year archive. Detected file name (PE2017.7z) folder sits (2024/, 2023-legado/), rais_download() lays cache; pass explicitly file kept elsewhere. chunk_size Number lines parsed per chunk. Larger chunks faster use memory; default (500,000 lines 60 columns) uses well 1 GB. verbose Emit progress messages? Defaults getOption("raisr.verbose", TRUE).

title: Read a RAIS archive as a stream — rais_read
text: tibble selected records columns, plus two columns added package: rais_year (reference year) rais_type ("vinculos" "estabelecimentos"). Column names normalized: accents removed, lower case, words separated _, identical across two header generations. Returns empty tibble record matches.

what: raisr: Access 'RAIS' Microdata from the Brazilian Ministry of Labour — raisr-package
title: raisr: Access 'RAIS' Microdata from the Brazilian Ministry of Labour — raisr-package
text: Download read public, non-identified microdata 'RAIS' (Relação Anual de Informações Sociais), annual census formal employment relationships establishments published Brazilian Ministry Labour Employment 'PDET' FTP server <ftp://ftp.mtps.gov.br/pdet/microdados/RAIS/>. Lists years archives available server, resolves regional state archive holds given state, downloads idempotent local cache, reads '7z' archives stream, filtering state selecting columns anything kept memory, single state can extracted regional file tens millions records. Handles two header generations files ('RAIS' 2022 'RAIS' 2023 onwards) normalized column names, provides official record layout helper consolidate employment stock, admissions, separations December payroll.

title: raisr: Access 'RAIS' Microdata from the Brazilian Ministry of Labour — raisr-package

title: raisr 0.1.0
text: Initial release. rais_available() lists every archive published PDET/MTE FTP server, size, modification date edition (final, partial, legacy). rais_files() resolves offline archive holds state year (one file per state 2017, regional files 2018) rais_ufs() gives state table behind . rais_download() fetches archives idempotent local cache mirrors server layout (rais_cache_dir(), rais_cache_list(), rais_cache_clear()). mapping normalized column names; rais_fetch() combines download read several years. rais_stock() consolidates stock 31 December, admissions, separations December payroll grouping. rais_layout() documents columns employment establishment files, two header spellings . Sample archives inst/extdata (generations, employment establishments, plus pre-2018 state file) allow every reading function tried offline.
